decision: REP-01 方法限域通过后，申请扩至完整 B 工作区资源制作；只允许获批 Gate1 的三茶三奶六小料和同源杯组合，不新增玩法/UI视角。Tech 同 batch FULL-01 续签实存前不扩图。

scope.shared_cup_content: 3茶色/3奶纹/6小料形，共12可组合内容层；订单杯和工作杯只共用这一套内容，用各自前后容器与同源缩放在两尺寸合成。至少两组目标配方在气泡实际尺寸可辨；不预烘54杯。
scope.other_semantic_layers: 店框/街景静底、12空槽柜背、前柜遮挡、独立幽灵、独立气泡、订单杯前后壁、工作杯前后壁、三按钮底板/图标、可变高亮、锁定层、动态文字，冻结图参考层默认关闭。
scope.state_rule: B原示范常亮框从静底剥离，可按品种切换；未开放与选中不可烘在对象/空槽；字改由官方许可字体按Product批准名动态排版。
scope.client_resource_paths: PLANNED_ONLY until Gate2 approval; no Client import/UUID claim

method.working_color: frozen unprofiled RGB8 interpreted as sRGB; output straight-alpha RGBA8 PNG; fixed full-canvas layer coordinates and SrcOver
method.semantic_cutting: deterministic object-boundary masks retain visible frozen pixels; separate front occluders and empty backing; use local repair only where RGB source has no hidden information; no rectangle-slot substitute or full-image top cover
method.psd_tool: /Users/yuanquan/.codex/skills/bggg-creator-image2psd/scripts/image2psd.py assemble (read-only script), from actual transparent full-canvas semantic layers and mapping; never split-colors as semantics
method.font_source: /private/tmp/u05-b-font-source/ZCOOLKuaiLe-Regular.ttf plus OFL.txt; copy exact originals into this source batch if actual font export used and retain full license
method.change_masks: all planned change regions and repair patches must be enumerated; RGB outside approved masks equals frozen B byte-for-byte in reconstructed preview
method.transparent_limit: glass/jar original RGB cannot recover occluded rear optical information; only visible pixels plus documented local reconstruction; no claim of general physical transparency

checks: Every exported object gets measured nonzero-alpha bbox, crop offset and pivot; 12 empty slots with no residue; two shared-content cup combinations in order-bubble and work-cup sizes; all semantic layers reconstructed at 1024×1536 with reference layer off; outside-change-mask RGB difference 0; PSD layer existence and mapping verified. Actual Cocos/device memory/DrawCall/FPS remain NOT_TESTED before import.
limits: 本签不是 Gate2 用户资源批准；REP-01 的同一残影/褐底问题已用两轮，若全批同类再失败须停对应支线诊断，不靠追加生成绕开限制。
